name: Known defects (tracked with xfail)
description: Bugs in the apps under test that are recorded on purpose. They should stay red until fixed.

name: Accessibility regressions
description: A page gained a serious or critical axe-core violation that is not in a11y/baseline.json.

name: Visual regressions
description: A screen differs from its baseline in visual/baselines by more than the tolerance. Check the attached diff image.

name: API contract breaks
description: A response no longer matches its JSON Schema in api/schemas.py.

name: Timeouts and network issues
description: Usually the public demo site being slow or down, not a product bug. Re-run before triaging.

name: Product defects
description: An assertion failed: the app behaved differently from what the test expects.

name: Test defects
description: The test itself errored (fixture, selector or code problem) before it could assert.
